payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully

condition.question: Is her jacket fully closed?
condition.criteria: Compare the same visible region of the jacket’s front closure in SOURCE and EDITED. First determine whether corresponding closure cues are sufficiently visible in both images for a reliable comparison. If the changed viewpoint, occlusion, or pose prevents that comparison, fulfillment is unobservable; do not infer zero progress from an apparent opening or infer progress from a swinging panel, changed pose, or drape. When comparison is reliable, full achievement requires the front panels to meet along the closure with no visible opening. Partial achievement requires visible evidence that the panels have moved together along some portion of the closure while an opening remains. A visible opening without reliable corresponding comparison does not establish zero progress.
condition.binding: Compare the jacket on the woman in SOURCE with the jacket on the woman in EDITED. Assess the same front-closure region only when corresponding cues are reliably visible in both; otherwise leave fulfillment unresolved. The requested endpoint remains a fully closed jacket, and pose or garment movement alone is not closure progress.
condition.endpoint: Her jacket is fully closed, with no visible opening along the closure.
condition.necessity: This is the requested change and its complete endpoint.
condition.zero_when: Reliable comparison of corresponding visible closure cues shows no movement of the front panels toward meeting along the closure. Do not assign zero when viewpoint, occlusion, or pose prevents reliable comparison, and do not use a swinging panel or changed drape as evidence of zero progress.
condition.half_when: Reliable corresponding closure cues show that the front panels have moved together along part of the closure, but a visible opening remains. Pose or drape change alone is not partial fulfillment; if corresponding cues cannot be compared reliably, fulfillment is unresolved.
condition.full_when: The front panels meet along the visible closure with no visible opening remaining. If the same closure region is not sufficiently visible to establish this reliably, fulfillment is unresolved rather than full.
